description: Bracket-card score-difference sparkline (Issue #24 proposal c) + e2e coverage + docs. Add a tiny inline-SVG score-diff sparkline to each SeriesCard summarizing the per-game run differentials (reusing FEAT-001 seriesScoreDiffs), with an accessible aria-label. It must stay subtle and theme-aware, must NOT bloat the card or break the #22 keyboard roving model, the #18 favorite highlight, or mobile layout (no overflow at 375px). Then add Playwright e2e, run the full verification suite, and update the specs + both READMEs (spec-driven dev is graded).
steps: Create a small Sparkline component (e.g. in frontend/src/components/SeriesFlowCharts.tsx as a named export, or a dedicated frontend/src/components/ScoreDiffSparkline.tsx) that takes { series } and renders a compact inline SVG of per-game run differentials (small bars or a mini line) colored by winning team via teamColor; height a few px, width scaling with game count. Give it role=img with a localized aria-label summarizing the games (e.g. 'Score differences by game: ...'). Render nothing (or an empty state) when the series has no games.

Render the sparkline inside SeriesCard.tsx in a non-intrusive spot (e.g. near the series meta line), only when series.games.length > 0. Ensure it does NOT add focusable elements (keep it aria-hidden children / role=img), so the roving-tabindex keyboard model (BracketView) and Enter/Space activation are unchanged. Keep markup minimal so card heights stay consistent.

Add sparkline CSS to frontend/src/styles.css using theme variables; verify it is subtle and does not cause horizontal overflow at 375px (constrain width/max-width; the bracket already scrolls, so the sparkline must fit within the card content width).
Localize the sparkline aria-label (new MessageKey + ja/en). Default JA.

Add a component test (extend SeriesCard.test.tsx or add to SeriesFlowCharts.test.tsx) asserting the sparkline renders with its role=img/aria-label for a series with games and renders nothing for a games-less series; and a quick assertion that SeriesCard still exposes its existing card label / keyboard affordances (no regression).

Add Playwright e2e: (1) extend/add frontend/e2e specs so opening a 2024 series detail (seed data, offline fallback — navigate to /season/2024 then into a finished series, or deep-link) asserts the score-diff bar chart + cumulative trend chart + the tabular alternative <table> all render and NO probability chart appears. (2) For the predictable season, the e2e fixture SAMPLE_2026_BRACKET's final ALCS (117 vs 136) HAS games — open its detail at /season/2026/series/2026-al-championship-117-136 and assert the probability-trend chart + its prob column render (predictable season). (3) Assert a bracket card shows the sparkline (role=img) on the home page. (4) Capture a DARK-mode screenshot of a series detail with charts into frontend/test-results for legibility review (set theme via localStorage or the toggle, as a11y.spec.ts does). Reuse e2e fixtures/stubs in frontend/e2e/fixtures.ts. NOTE: 2026 WS series has empty games so no prob chart there — use the ALCS which has games for the overlay assertion.

Run the FULL verification: npm run build; npm test; npm run test:e2e -w frontend (run `npx playwright install chromium` first if needed); npm run synth. Confirm #22 keyboard (keyboard.spec.ts), #18 favorites (favorites.spec.ts), #17/#20 UI, and a11y (a11y.spec.ts) specs are unregressed.

Update docs truthfully: add the series-flow visualization to .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/requirements.md, design.md, and tasks.md (new requirement + design of the pure helpers, SVG+table accessibility approach, prob overlay reusing predict/backtest truncation, sparkline, dark-mode theming), and add a user-facing section to BOTH README.md and README.ja.md describing the feature and that it works on seed seasons without a prediction overlay. Mention it is frontend-only reusing the shared predict().
acceptance_criteria: Each SeriesCard with games shows a subtle, theme-aware inline-SVG score-diff sparkline with a localized aria-label (role=img); cards without games show none.
The sparkline does not add focusable elements and does not regress the #22 roving-tabindex keyboard model, the #18 favorite highlight, or cause horizontal overflow at 375px.

Playwright e2e proves: a 2024 (seed) series detail renders the score-diff + cumulative charts + tabular alternative and NO prob chart; a predictable 2026 series-with-games detail renders the probability-trend chart; a bracket card shows the sparkline; and a dark-mode screenshot is captured.
npm run build, npm test, npm run test:e2e -w frontend, and npm run synth all pass; keyboard/favorites/a11y e2e specs remain green.
Specs (.kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/*) and BOTH README.md and README.ja.md are updated to describe the feature truthfully.
findings:
Built the bracket-card score-diff sparkline + e2e + docs. NEW component frontend/src/components/ScoreDiffSparkline.tsx: <ScoreDiffSparkline series> renders a compact inline-SVG strip of per-game run-margin bars (reusing FEAT-001 seriesScoreDiffs), each bar fill = teamColor(winnerTeamId).primary with a neutral var(--muted) fallback; it is a SINGLE role=img element with a localized aria-label and ALL children aria-hidden, NO tabindex and NO interactive node, so it adds zero tab stops. Returns null for a games-less series. Wired into SeriesCard.tsx just below the series meta line, rendered only when series.games.length>0; placed so it does not touch the #18 favorite-highlight markup. CSS .series-card__sparkline added to styles.css: fixed height 18px, max-width:100% (no 375px overflow), opacity 0.85 for subtlety; theme-aware via teamColor fills + var(--muted).

i18n: added ONE new MessageKey flow.sparkline.label to the union AND both ja/en tables (ja default): en 'Run differential sparkline, {count} games: {summary}', ja '得点差スパークライン（{count}試合）: {summary}'. The {summary} is built as '{winnerAbbr} +{diff}' per game (dash when no winner).

Component tests (frontend/src/components/SeriesCard.test.tsx, 3 new): sparkline renders with role=img + localized aria-label 'Run differential sparkline, 2 games: DET +2, DET +3' for a series with games and is an <svg> with no tabindex/no inner button; renders nothing (and no .series-card__sparkline) for a games-less series; the card keeps its tabindex=0 roving affordance + accessible aria-label and exposes exactly its existing 3 interactive controls (2 favorite toggles + games toggle), proving no extra tab stop/no regression.

E2E (frontend/e2e/series-flow.spec.ts, 4 tests, all pass): (1) 2024 seed detail (/season/2024/series/2024-al-wildcard-117-116, offline fallback) renders the diff + trend charts (role=img ja names 試合ごとの得点差 / シリーズ累計勝利数) and the collapsed tabular alternative (opened via the データ表を表示 toggle, winner shown as text 勝利), with NO probability chart (試合ごとの予測勝利確率 count 0). (2) predictable 2026 ALCS with games (stubBracket2026, /season/2026/series/2026-al-championship-117-136) renders ALL three charts incl the probability-trend chart + a % probability column. (3) a home-page bracket card (2026 final ALCS) shows the sparkline (role=img, name /得点差スパークライン/) with no tabindex. (4) captures a DARK-mode detail screenshot to the gitignored test-results/series-flow-dark.png (theme seeded via localStorage mlb.theme='dark' as a11y.spec.ts does).

FULL verification all green (PATH prefix): npm run build (shared->backend->frontend->infra); npm test = shared 37, backend 94, frontend 187, infra 8 (all pass); npm run test:e2e -w frontend = 46 passed INCLUDING the unregressed keyboard.spec.ts (#22 roving tabindex + Enter), favorites.spec.ts (#18), a11y.spec.ts (axe light+dark, zero serious/critical), home.spec.ts (incl the 375px no-overflow test), refresh/game-times/prediction/i18n specs; npm run synth green. Confirmed 375px/no-overflow and the #22 keyboard, #18 favorites, and a11y specs are unregressed.

Docs updated truthfully: .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/requirements.md (new Requirement 18, 7 acceptance criteria), design.md (new 'Series-flow visualization' section: pure helpers, SVG+table accessibility approach, prob overlay reusing predict()/shared seriesProbTrend truncation, the sparkline, dark-mode theming), tasks.md (new task section with FEAT-001/002/003 subtasks marked done, Requirements: 18), and a user-facing 'Series-flow visualization' / 'シリーズの流れの可視化' section added to BOTH README.md and README.ja.md (kept in sync; notes it works on seed/past seasons WITHOUT a prediction overlay and is frontend-only reusing the shared predict()). No em dashes in the new content. Commits in order: 78b8f53 feat(issue-24): bracket-card score-diff sparkline + series-flow e2e; 63478bc docs(issue-24): document series-flow visualization in specs and both READMEs.

REVIEW FOLLOW-UP (2026-10-05, non-blocking issues from 2026-10-05-104000-review.md, both addressed): (1) Sparkline '- +0' summary -- ScoreDiffSparkline.summarize() no longer prepends '+' unconditionally; a game with winnerTeamId===null now renders a localized 'no result' phrase instead of claiming a '+0' margin. New localized MessageKey flow.sparkline.noResult added to the union + BOTH ja/en tables (en 'no result', ja '結果なし'). Decided games are unchanged ('{abbr} +{diff}'). Added a SeriesCard.test.tsx case: a decided + in-progress 2-game series reads 'DET +2, no result' and asserts the label does NOT contain '+0'. (2) predictable prop suppress-only -- simplified the SeriesFlowCharts render guard from `seasonPredictable && isPredictable(season) && games>0` to `seasonPredictable && games>0` (dropped the redundant re-check) and updated the prop JSDoc to say it defaults to isPredictable(season) and only gates the overlay (no false claim it can force-enable). Observable behavior is unchanged for the sole SeriesDetailPage caller, which passes predictable={isPredictable(season)}, so seasonPredictable resolves identically. Verification all green with the PATH prefix: npm test -w @mlb/frontend = 188 passed; npm run build = shared/backend/frontend/infra all built; npm run test:e2e -w frontend = 46 passed (series-flow, keyboard #22, favorites #18, a11y all unregressed). Commit: see follow-up commit hash in task log.
